files.description: Bike-share trips, 1 September to 1 November 2025 (1500 rows): trip_id (whole number), rider_id (refers to riders.csv), start_station and end_station (refer to station_code in stations.csv), started_at (timestamp written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), duration_min (whole minutes; about 3% empty), distance_km (two decimals), fare (two decimals; about 3% empty), payment (card, app or cash; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), rating (1-5 stars, whole number; about 19% empty).

task_text: From trips.csv, compute the average distance_km of trips for each weekday of started_at and each payment method (trimmed and lower-cased). `result` should be a table with weekdays as rows named Monday to Sunday in that order and payment methods as columns in alphabetical order, values rounded to 2 decimals.
intended_computation: Read trips.csv; clean payment (strip, lower case); mean distance_km per (weekday of started_at, payment); rows Monday to Sunday in that order, columns payment methods in alphabetical order; values rounded to 2 decimals.

acceptable_variants.notes: weekday labels may be spelled differently in letter case
